items.title: Zelenskyy fires Ukraine's tech-savvy defense minister in government reshuffle
items.description: Ukraine's President Volodymyr Zelenskyy has fired the country's popular defense minister, who pushed for innovation in the battlefield through the use of drones and turned the tables on Russia.

items.title: Over 500 feared dead in two suspected shipwrecks off Myanmar, UN warns
items.description: Two United Nations agencies reported Thursday the ships that disappeared in recent weeks were carrying more than 500 people from Myanmar's war-torn Rakhine State. Most of the people on the vessels were thought to be members of the country's Muslim Rohingya minority.

items.title: Russia Fires 6,001 Drones, 170 Bombs as Ukraine Repels 235 Clashes
items.description: The Armed Forces of Ukraine repelled 235 clashes across the front line on Wednesday, July 15, with the heaviest fighting near Pokrovsk and Kostiantynivka. Russian forces used 170 guided bombs and 6,001 kamikaze drones during the assault.

items.title: Palestinians in Gaza: Stuck between Hamas and Israel

items.title: Winter was harsh, but resilient Odesa making summer a season of hope
items.description: Odesa, home to a Ukrainian seaport that is a critical link in the global food security chain, endured its worst winter of Russian attacks since the war began, then prepared for a vibrant summer with a determination not just to survive but to build a better future.
